crossRefs.note: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

translations.web: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),
translations.bsb: And I know that this man—whether in the body or out of it I do not know, but God knows—
translations.kjv: And I knew such a man, (whether in the body, or out of the body, I cannot tell: God knoweth;)
translations.asv: And I know such a man (whether in the body, or apart from the body, I know not; God knoweth),
